$comment: Config for scripts/mobile-gate.mjs — the mobile & tablet gate that /ship runs.
Thresholds are contractual: do NOT relax them to make a red run green.
Every entry under `ignore` MUST carry a justification and a follow-up issue in $waivers.

`routes` is the PUBLIC pass — only routes an anonymous visitor actually reaches. The app is a login wall (app.routes.ts hangs canActivateChild [authGuard, approvedGuard] on the shell), so anything behind it must live under `auth.routes`: put it here and the gate would measure the login page and call it GREEN. The `auth-redirect` check now catches that, but the right list is still the cheaper fix.

`auth` drives the opt-in --auth pass (#516). `auth.routes` are audited on EVERY device; `auth.panelRoutes` open the feedback FAB and stay phones-only, because above 720px the panel is a docked window rather than the full-bleed sheet under test. Credentials come from SC_GATE_EMAIL / SC_GATE_PASSWORD — never from this file.
